description: This file contains utility functions and mocks for testing browser server context and remote tab operations, including state creation, fetch mocking, and tab list management.

methods.name: makeState
methods.description: Creates a browser server state object with profile-specific configuration.

methods.name: makeUnexpectedFetchMock
methods.description: Returns a mock fetch function that throws an error when called.

methods.name: createRemoteRouteHarness
methods.description: Sets up a test harness for remote browser route with optional fetch mock.

methods.name: createSequentialPageLister
methods.description: Returns an async function that yields responses sequentially from a provided array.

methods.name: createJsonListFetchMock
methods.description: Creates a mock fetch function that returns a list of JSON entries for a specific URL pattern.

methods.name: makeManagedTab
methods.description: Generates a mock tab entry with specified id and ordinal.

methods.name: makeManagedTabsWithNew
methods.description: Creates a list of mock tabs, optionally placing a new tab at the beginning.
